summary: Checked all six estimates against the extraction specification, creativity codebook, and paper. Read the complete markdown conversion, including references and Appendices A-BC, and extracted every cited source page with PyMuPDF. Table 1 and the participant methods confirm 18 analyzed people per original arm and 54 overall; the two-arm totals and randomized counts are not inferred. The teacher-rated uniqueness, AI-judge uniqueness, and n-gram repetition records correctly identify the original-session outcomes, arms, measures, units, directions, AI availability, timing, comparison types, and absence of randomized condition order. Their null effect statistics and not_reported uncertainty are supported: no exact full-sample original-session contrast statistics are printed for these outcomes. The other NLP displays do not establish an additional eligible phase-specific full-sample contrast; figure-only values were not transcribed. Optional tool-switch follow-up comparisons, writing-proficiency ratings, self-reports, recall measures, and EEG results do not supply omitted eligible estimates. No confirmed discrepancy found.
